book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Kiyo ki Yuude to
Juu chi Ŋka wumu wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Bɛntɛko gɛ̀ to chi kojɛ, bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ leesɛ fitele yi Jiso le, bo taashɛ kijusɛ kimimia.
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo jaŋe bo yu no fiɛɛ fuune fi shiide we njɛ mwacha. Fi shii fi lee fi yisɛ yeh yichii yì bo gɛ̀ bee yu.
Bo doo bo bijɛ, bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fimi fi nyu njɛ chilɛme chiŋgu, fi mo fi saaŋe fi gɛɛŋ yi bo le muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa.
Kiyo ki Yuude mo ki yisɛ yi bo le bachii, ki ge bo tu bo jɛme jɛ́ yi bituŋ yeye yeye.
Gɛ̀ bee kife kɛɛ le, Bajuu ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Nyo le gɛ̀ bee Yɛlusalɛm, bo ja bituŋ le bichii bi yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le.

No bo yu noo, bo mo bo taashɛ bo to wesee fɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le. Bamii ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le bayu mo bo jɛme, muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bo le yuge a jɛ́ yiboo le. Fi fuuŋsɛ bo.
Jwe yuŋ bo, bo tu bo ghaade, bo duu lɛ, “Gɛ bamii ba jɛme banɛ bachii nyu bamii ba Galalee gɛ?
Fi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ bee yuge muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bo le jɛme a jɛ́ yi bituŋ biɛsa le?
Bee bamu ja Batia, bamu ja Mɛde bɛ Ɛlaŋ, bamu ja Misobotɛmia bɛ Judia mo Kafadosia, bamu ja Bontu bɛ Ɛsia.
Bee bamu ja Fligia bɛ Banfilia, bamu Ijib bɛ bimbe bi Libia le, bì le mbebe a kilaantɛŋ kì Sɛliŋ le. Bee bamu ja Lum, nyu Bajuu bɛ bamii bo kaase lo bo tu bamii ba mbɛmɛ wu Bajuu le.
Bee bamu ja Klɛt bɛ Alɛbia. Bee tu yuge a jɛ́ yi bituŋ biɛsa le yeye yeye no bamii banɛ jɛme biŋgha bi mwɛɛ bì Nyo gee.”
Jwe yuŋ bo, bo tu bo maŋe lɛbolɛbo laa finɛ fiɛɛ duunyi lɛ la lɛ.
Bamii bamu tu bo keede lo fiboo bo duu lɛ, “Bamii banɛ le mbvuuŋ koo wa bo.”
Bita jɛme bamii le

Noo, Bita bɛ kimbɛge ki booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho wu mumwaa mo bo lɛɛŋ fo. Bita mo wu kɛ wu tu wu jɛme kinchvu ki bamii le fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Bɛŋ Bajuu mo bamii bachii ba chee Yɛlusalɛm, ŋgoone lɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ finɛ. Bɛŋ nyâ bintuŋ chuule yi fiɛɛ fì nlé njɛmɛ bɛŋ le.
Mbvuuŋ baaŋ koo gɛ bamii banɛ no bɛŋ kwaji gɛ. Mɛɛse baaŋ gɛh lo juu bikaa bvuugɛ antaana.
Fiɛɛ fì kooshi finɛ mɛɛse le fì Juɛl wù muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nyo duu lɛ, lé doo nyûme yi aju a kimɛsɛ le,
wu chvû Kiyo ke yi bamii le bachii.
Noo booŋ bena ba bilɛŋsɛ mo ba bikɛse,
bo yûge mwɛɛ mù wu jɛme, bo sɛŋe bamii le,
mwɛɛ njɛ bifilɛ too fɛ chuu yi bamii bena le,
bifilɛ laane ŋgaamii bena.
Lé ge doo nyûme aju ayu le,
wu chvû Kiyo ke yi bamii ba lɛme be le bachii,
bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse,
bo yûge mwɛɛ mù wu jɛme, bo sɛŋe bamii le.
Fi le lɛ wu gee mwɛɛ mu jwe wu yune le fɛwe,
wu ka wu gee mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bwe yi nshɛŋ le.
Kilɛmɛ bɛ ŋgu mo chinjige chì kuufe ye le chi nyûme.
Juu lé chi gê chi jîmɛ,
kwii jâ wu yɛ̂ɛde njɛ kilɛmɛ,
fɛ juu chi baaŋ chi Tada chi kiŋgha ge chi to.
Noo, le yɛɛŋ wù lé wu gê wu lɛ̂ge Tada, wu lé wu gê wu bvûsɛ wu.’”

content: Bita ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bamii ba Ishwala, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû chuule fiɛɛ fì njɛme. Jiso wu Nasalɛ gɛ̀ bee muh wù Nyo gɛ̀ dunyɛ bɛŋ le chuule lɛ le wu wù tuŋ wu no wu gɛ̀ ge Jiso gee mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo, bɛ mwɛɛ mu de yì yunɛ, bɛ biŋgha bi mwɛɛ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ. Bɛŋ kee mwɛɛ munɛ chuule.
Jiso wunɛ le muh wù ba gɛ̀ nya bɛŋ le, gɛ̀ seese Nyo fi ge fi kooshi wu gɛ̀ kee wa. Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ yuuyɛ wu no bɛŋ gɛ̀ nya wu chiaaŋ yi bamii ba befe le, ba ta wu yi kintaaŋ le.
Geenɛ, Nyo kaasɛ wu bvusɛ wu yi kwe le, wu bonɛ chiaaŋ yi kwe le nje gɛ kwe gɛ̀ taŋlo yi mɛ yi jiji wu le gɛ.
Dabi gɛ̀ bee wu jɛmɛ wa kune Jiso wunɛ wu duu lɛ,

content.text: ‘N'yɛde Tada le wu nyu besa wu segechiikibo kaŋ kinchiɛɛŋ le,
gɛ taŋlo fiɛɛ shîŋshɛ mɛ gɛ.
Noo, fitele fiaŋ mo fi yuge njoŋ,
njɛme bɛ kinlaŋye.
Nle muh nyu ŋge ŋkwe gɛh lo,
geenɛ njiiŋe gɛh nyu fwe,
nje gɛ wo wù Nyo nyu wo ge wo chinɛ kiyo kaŋ woŋ wu baŋkfu le gɛ.
Gɛ wo nyu wo ge wo chinɛ Mwa yo wu lɛme wù Yuude wu fo a jɛŋ gɛ.
Wo le wo dunyɛ wa mɛ je yì taŋlo nfê yu fɛ mbonɛ.
Nlé ŋgê nlaŋeye, no nlé ŋgê nyume a wo fwe.’”

content: Bita ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, taŋlo njɛme bɛŋ le n'ya maŋe gɛ lɛ chiji chiji wese wu Nfoŋ Dabi gɛ̀ kwe, ba jiiyɛ wu, jɛŋ ye le fɛnɛ too bude abɛŋ.
Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo, wu ka kee ŋka wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka wa wu yu, wu ji leh lɛ wu lé wu gê wu gɛɛ mwa wu a kfuu che le yi kala we le.
Wu mo wu yaŋsɛ wu yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì Nyo gɛ̀ bee ki wu gê le, wu jɛmɛ lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka lé wu gê wu bû yi kwe le. Le fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Wu gɛ̀ baaŋ mɛ gɛh woŋ wu baŋkfu le gɛ,
ye ye gɛ̀ baaŋ fo gɛ a jɛŋ gɛ.’

content: Jiso wunɛ Nyo gɛ̀ bvusɛ wu yi kwe le, bee bachii be le bamii be ba ŋgoo bee gɛ yɛŋ wu le.
Nyo le wu bɛɛŋsɛ wa wu, wu shiishɛ wu a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le, wu nya wu Kiyo ki Yuude no wu gɛ̀ ka. Fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ yɛde bɛŋ ka yuge mɛɛse le Kiyo kiyu kì Jiso nya bee le.
Gɛ nyu Dabi wù gɛ̀ bɛnɛ we gɛ. Dabi kibɛɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ fie lɛ,

content.text: ‘Tada Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ Tada waŋ le lɛ,
“shilɛ a kibo kaŋ kinchiɛɛŋ le,
gɛɛŋ bu sege nlé ŋgê ŋgîiŋsɛ bamii buŋ ba kimbanɛ,
wo tomɛ bikaa biuŋ yi bo le njɛ kitege ki bikaa.”’

content: Noo, bamii bachii ba Ishwala mo bo kêe chuule lɛ Jiso wunɛ wù bɛŋ gɛ̀ ta yi kintaaŋ le, le wu wù Nyo le wu gɛɛ wa lɛ le Tada ka nyu Mbvusɛ wù wu gɛ̀ ka.”
No bamii bayu yu noo, njɛme wɛɛ koo bo. Bo mo bo biih Bita bɛ kimbɛge ki booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le lɛ, “Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bee lé be gê nɛɛ mɛɛse?”
Bita chvuu bo le lɛ, “Muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa kûsɛ fitele fie, ba lêesɛ wu a joo a jee chi Jiso Kletu le lɛ Nyo lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ bie wu ka wu nyâ wu bɛ nnya yi Kiyo ki Yuude.
Ŋka wuyu wunɛ le fɛ bɛŋ le, bɛ fɛ booŋ bena le, ka nyume fɛ bamii bachii ba le yaga le. Fi le lɛ wu fɛ bamii bachii ba Tada Nyo wese tɛŋe lɛ bo too fɛ wu le.”
Bita ka wu jɛme mwɛɛ wesee, wu teefe bo, wu chiisɛ lɛ bo fîh bikwɛɛ biboo yi ŋgɛ wù lé wu gê wu tô yi kiŋgogɛ kì befe kinɛ le.
Bamii yu njɛmɛ wu Bita wunɛ, ba duude bɛɛŋ, ba mo ba leesɛ bo a joo. Juu chiyu bamii taa fɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba Jiso le njɛ banchvuge batɛde (3,000).
Bo mo bo nya bikwɛɛ biboo, bo yuge mwɛɛ nyu mù booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛ yɛyi. Bɛ bo mo bo nyu yi kintaashɛ le, bo bwɛɛyi blɛd, bo ka bo buune yi kintaashɛ le.
Kinche ki ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso tu bo gêe mwɛɛ mu de yì yunɛ bɛ mwɛɛ wesee mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo, bamii yɛde, fi ghage lo bo.
Ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ bachii tu bo nyu yi muh le wu mumwaa, bo kɛme fiɛɛ fiboo fimimia.
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo gese manjuu maboo bɛ mwɛɛ muboo, bo gade bige biyu lɛbolɛbo no ŋgɛ wu muh gɛ̀ bee.
Bo mo bo shee bo taashi fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le aju achii, bo jii mwɛɛ yi kintaashɛ le, a la le bɛ kinlaŋye fɛ muntele muboo le, bo yɛɛde gɛ ajii gɛ,
bo yuusɛ Nyo. Bamii bachii koŋe bo. Tada tu wu fii bamii aju achii, wu taade yi ŋgoo yiboo le.
